summary: VM-side --phase d crashes from Hub-only artifacts: twin_validation.json is read locally and never refetched from the dataset repo
evidence: i591_e2_dispatch.py:1022 reads ctx.out_root/twin_validation.json directly; manifest (:999) and panel JSONs (_ensure_panel_local) have refetch paths. Production split is --phase abc pod-side then --phase d VM-side post-termination, so Phase D crashes before producing extended_panel_results.json. Fix: mirror the manifest/panel refetch pattern + add a --phase d smoke from an empty out-root.
